lines.text: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall, Humpty Dumpty had a great fall!
Did you know eggshells are actually built like super strong architecture domes?
All the king's horses and all the king's men couldn't put Humpty together again!
An egg's curved dome shape spreads weight evenly around the whole shell!
That is why mother birds can sit on eggs without breaking them at all!
But when Humpty hits a hard stone wall on one sharp point, the calcium cracks!
Nature gave eggs dome engineering millions of years before humans built bridges!
Now you know the real dome secret behind Humpty Dumpty!
